verdict.rationale: The GST portal is an online filing system, so publishing operating hours, per-day limits, or session timeouts up front is a fair question to ask of it. Nothing in the evidence pack covers any of these. The 'Upcoming Due Dates' listing and the login help modules are adjacent material about deadlines and credential management, not service windows or session limits.

support.subject: As a founder, any operating-hours window, per-day limit, or session timeout on the online flow is published up front, before I start
